gloss: to back away; to step back

definitions.gloss: to back away; to step back; to retreat
definitions.explanation: To move backward, typically out of fear, surprise, or discomfort. Often implies an instinctive, involuntary reaction.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}わず{後|あと}ずさった。
{大|おお}きな{犬|いぬ}に{吠|ほ}えられて、{後|あと}ずさった。
examples.english: A large dog barked at me and I backed away.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{剣幕|けんまく}に{圧倒|あっとう}されて、{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}たちは{後|あと}ずさりした。
examples.english: Overwhelmed by his fury, the people around him backed away.

notes: A godan verb. Can also be written as {後退|あとずさ}る, though the mixed kana-kanji form is more common. The noun form is {後|あと}ずさり. The verb often collocates with {思|おも}わず (involuntarily) or じりじりと (gradually/bit by bit). Also written as {後|あと}じさる in some dialects. Differs from {退|しりぞ}く, which is more formal and implies a deliberate or strategic retreat.
